history.summary: Plan completed and committed (de61e94): pre-settled shape; P1 (KubeCoderDeploy chart declares IfNotPresent on the five pinned containers, gated, and replays HelmCharts drift), P2 (KubeCoderDeploy promote job: retag -> fast-forward prd -> release-<m>), P3 (the per-stage cutover runbook in Ansible docs/runbooks, plus argocd.md's diff table corrected); verification.json covers R1-R14, sequencing and exit 1:1 (22 items). Two close-out suggestions: D2 unrecorded in the argo-cd set; the Jenkins linter only parse-checks scripted Jenkinsfiles.

Structurally sound (ACs 1:1 with slice.md, Targets and phases right, no attachments), but the settled premise that R4's no-destroy plan runs from this pod's iac sidecar with no secret read is false: the sidecar has no HOMELAB_* credentials, homelab_zfs_dataset refuses to configure without HOMELAB_IAC_PROVISIONER_TOKEN, and V04/V20 are written on that premise. How R4's plan is credentialed, and where it runs, is the operator's call.
